Name: Groceries
Author: cupoflifenoodles
Description:
Rather than shipping her low-tier products, Marnie will now sell milk and eggs at her shop counter at a balanced price. The idea is to help with cooking goals and save space in your fridge instead of having an egg, a large egg, a silver large egg, a gold large brown egg... etc.

I have hopes of expanding this mod eventually as a way to teach myself modding and add more grocery items to various shops, to save the pain of having to keep staple items you can only grow in one season around all the time, taking up space. Let me know if there's anything you'd like to see!

Current things this mod adds:
[spoiler]Egg (white) - Available by default
Duck Egg - Available once you have a duck and it has produced at least one egg
Milk - Available by default
Goat Milk - Available once you have a goat and it has produced at least one milk
Cloth - Available once you have seen the cutscene where Emily invites you to use her sewing machine (the cutscene is triggered by picking up a cloth from any source for the first time). Let's go SDV clothes horses 💪💪[/spoiler]

Planning to add in the near future:
[spoiler]Fire Quartz - Robin starting when you reach level 80? maybe level 90? in mines
Clay - Robin
Blue Egg - Marnie starting year 2 (from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo[/url] mod. would let you skip befriending Shane)
Dwarf Scrolls - Marlon starting when you reach level 120 (bottom) in mines
Bug Meat - From SOMEWHERE. Krobus? Raccoon Wife if I can figure out how to do that maybe?
Tomato - Joja and then Pierre if Joja closes (the idea is Pierre picks up the contract with the seller)
Onion - Joja and then Pierre if Joja closes

I'm considering adding the Ridgeside Village forage to the Ridgeside general store but that's a bigger undertaking and a while off[/spoiler]

[b]I am new to modding so if anything doesn't work, please let me know![/b]

Inspired by the lovely, now-defunct [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6753]Marnie Sells Animal Products[/url].

Feel free to comment on pricing balance. I'm sure there's a way to cheese this somehow, but if you want to cheese it that bad I guess that's your choice.

Mods pictured here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks - Producer
[/url]

Downloads.Description: Added duck eggs and goat milk. Both are permanently unlocked when anyone on the server has the relevant animal and it produces for the first time. I haven't used this kind of argument before so let me know if it isn't working right!
